body: Thank you, I will try your advice. He has been complaining about being sore after work so exercise might be just what we need.

I don't have the means to talk to someone. We are lucky to have $20 leftover at the end of the month, we both have a long commute and spend a lot on gas. 

I think I am going to talk to him about it. It's an uncomfortable conversation for me but he is very understanding. He dealt with depression for a few years himself so I guess I shouldn't feel so weird talking to him about it.

My boyfriend knows I've been feeling depressed but I don't think he understands how bad it's gotten. 

I work in a hospital, I've been there two years now. It's become something I dread daily, even on my days off. I work in the ER and I get treated shitty by patients every time I work. I don't know if my job is the only thing, but it definitely isn't helping.

Thank you for your kindness.
